content: Ollama 0.30.6 supports structured outputs (format = JSON schema, Pydantic model_json_schema()) and tool calling. qwen2.5:3b = 1.9GB Q4_K_M, 32K ctx, tools; qwen2.5:1.5b = 986MB Q4_K_M, 32K ctx, tools. 0.5B/1.5B are Apache-2.0; 3B and 72B under Qwen license (still open-weights). Small-model tool-calling is unreliable; prefer structured output for extraction. Host has ~2.3GB available RAM -> prefer 1.5B primary, 3B aspirational.
